pairs: cum venit ad eum Nathan propheta,
when Nathan the prophet came to him,
according to your great mercy. And,
according to the plentitude of your compassion,
Amplius lava me ab iniquitate mea,
Wash me once again from my iniquity,
et a peccato meo munda me.
and cleanse me from my sin.
et peccatum meum contra me est semper.
and my sin is ever before me.
Against you only have I sinned,
and I have done evil before your eyes.
And so, you are justified in your words,
and you will prevail when you give judgment.
Ecce enim in iniquitatibus conceptus sum,
For behold, I was conceived in iniquities,
et in peccatis concepit me mater mea.
and in sinfulness did my mother conceive me.
For behold, you have loved truth.
incerta et occulta sapientiæ tuæ manifestasti mihi.
The obscure and hidden things of your wisdom, you have manifested to me.
You will sprinkle me with hyssop,
and I will be made whiter than snow.
you will grant gladness and rejoicing.
And the bones that have been humbled will exult.
Averte faciem tuam a peccatis meis,
Turn your face away from my sins,
Create a clean heart in me,
et spiritum rectum innova in visceribus meis.
And renew an upright spirit within my inmost being.
Ne projicias me a facie tua,
Do not cast me away from your face;
et spiritum sanctum tuum ne auferas a me.
and do not take your Holy Spirit from me.
Restore to me the joy of your salvation,
and confirm me with an unsurpassed spirit.
I will teach the unjust your ways,
and the impious will be converted to you.
et exsultabit lingua mea justitiam tuam.
and my tongue will extol your justice.
et os meum annuntiabit laudem tuam.
and my mouth will announce your praise.
Quoniam si voluisses sacrificium, dedissem utique;
For if you had desired sacrifice, I would certainly have given it,
but with holocausts, you will not be delighted.
A crushed spirit is a sacrifice to God.
in your good will toward Zion,
so that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.
Then you will accept the sacrifice of justice,
tunc imponent super altare tuum vitulos.
Then they will lay calves upon your altar.
